title: abutilon foetidum
intro: Abutilon foetidum, commonly known as the fetid abutilon, is a plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include lowering blood pressure, treating fever, and providing relief from respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Abutilon foetidum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which help in soothing and protecting the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
